text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The signal around here is just abysmal! At this rate...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... I'll run out of time... I've
been
waiting ever so patiently too...
Ngh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Rrgh! Well, I shall just have to find an
area with
better reception! And you!
Come help me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging by how desperate she seems,
she must be
waiting on a really
important message.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This area is nice and open, so we should
be able
to get some decent network
coverage...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Agh! I don't believe it! There's no
difference at all!
Any luck on your
phone?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ugh! This dingus of a network! To the next area!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! That's right! When one has low signal, then surely the solution is to get higher to reach it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "No signal"?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But why?! Surely we're closer to the
satellite now
than we were before!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Pardon?! Is the signal not broadcast from
a
satellite?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that phone network signals are

distributed via base station antennas.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you tell me that sooner?!
Where's an
antenna? I'll go to the next
town over to find one
if I must!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Where are you, reception?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We try out several more places in hopes
of
finding a better signal, but struggle to
get a
single bar anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text:
This giant mountain of yakisoba is totally

post-worthy!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text:
For sure! Let's get a vid of you eating it
and send
it to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They have enough reception to send a
video?
Could this be the salvation we've
been looking
for?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This must be what they mean when they say the darkest place is under the candlestick. I'd never have suspected that snack shack would have Wi-Fi.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But now I can finally... finally...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Finally watch my show!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why, yes! Today's the day the latest episode of The Noble Court becomes available to watch online!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The main character is set to appear in
court for
the very first time! She's been
diligently preparing
for the case, and
now the critical moment's finally
arrived!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It'd be devastating if the stream
suddenly froze
while I was watching it!
What a relief that I
actually managed to
download the episode.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe we braved mountains and

coastlines solely to download an episode
of a
show. Although, it does warm my
heart to see
King Halo looking so
happy...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, excuse me? What are you grinning
about?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! J-just to let you know, my frantic
behavior
had nothing to do with my
fondness for this
series!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It was certainly not for such a childish
reason! This
was just... Uh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Duty! It's akin to a duty!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
One who is first-rate must remain acutely
aware
of popular trends!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Especially foreign TV series that are becoming a hot topic among celebrities around the world!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And besides, once I started watching, I
grew
curious as to how the story would
unfold.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The episodes always end on such
cliffhangers, you
see. I wonder what
happens after that last one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like King Halo is desperate to
watch the
next episode of her show. I
shouldn't keep her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like King Halo is desperate to
watch the
next episode of her show. I
shouldn't keep her.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I have every intention of doing just that! In fact, you ought to—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Well, hmm. How should I put this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You served me splendidly today! I
hereby
commend your efforts!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, relish in your joy as you get some
proper
rest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After issuing her command, King Halo
practically
flounces back to her room.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I won't! Who do you take me
for? It's
only a single episode, so it's
quite all right! And
besides...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a viewer with first-rate self-control,
I'd never
watch more than the set
number of episodes I
decide for myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she makes this assertion, King Halo
brims with
confidence in her ability to
resist binging on her
show and pulling an
all-nighter.
